summary: Southern Missouri Bancorp filed an 8-K reporting preliminary Q3 fiscal 2026 results and declaring a quarterly dividend of $0.25 per common share. The filing is a routine earnings and dividend announcement, not a special situation. No acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, capital return program (beyond ordinary dividend), spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC event, or forced management change is described. The press release attached discusses financial performance and conference call details. The dividend continues the company's 128th consecutive quarterly payout. This is a standard current report on operating results and dividend declaration.
